entry.author: New Zealand Trade and Enterprise
entry.summary:
Hamish Ewart is an NZTE Beachhead and a brand marketing specialist with 25+ years of experience in Australia and the USA. In this video he explains why you should build localised buyer personas for new export markets, who you should build them for, how to make them factual using research, and how to use them to shape your digital marketing.

Download buyer persona templates for B2C and B2B at myNZTE. https://my.nzte.govt.nz/article/how-to-create-buyer-personas-to-tailor-your-marketing
